messages:
Maria S.: @Auditor_Jess quick Q from your checklist: you asked for 'evidence of KMS key usage and RBAC changes for the past 90 days' do you want raw CloudTrail rows or the packaged evidence bundle we put in secure S3?

Auditor_Jess: Packaged bundle is fine. Need per-request principal, key-id, action, result, rotation events, and any auth failures. Also include a control mapping to SOC2/ISO IDs.

Kevin L.: We can produce: kms-usage.csv (row-per-request), kms-rotations.json (rotation events), rbac-diffs-2024-11-05.csv (terraform state diffs + commit refs). ETA: today EOD. Any notes on retention exceptions to surface?

Auditor_Jess: If any segments were archived beyond 90 days, include the authorized exception and reason. Also mark any partial ingestion/backfills.

Dmitri: FYI: collector gap in eu-west-1 on 2024-11-05 03:103:45 UTC (INC-2024-451). Backfill done from encrypted backup; we'll attach backfill proof and incident ticket.

Lina (infra): Packaging plan: s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1745554322/{kms-usage.csv,kms-rotations.json,rbac-diffs-2024-11-05.csv,index.md,backfill.log}. index.md will include control crosswalk (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9 etc.) and short rationale.

Maria S.: PR with the RBAC change: https://github.com/redwood/platform-admin/pull/2088 shows service-account removal and approver. I'll attach the approver confirmation and signed commit message.

Kevin L.: Export snippets for reproducibility:
```
# Splunk -> CSV (example)
splunk search "index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:kms (ActionName=Decrypt OR ActionName=GenerateDataKey* OR ActionName=Encrypt)" -earliest "-90d" | outputcsv kms-usage.csv

# copy to evidence bucket
aws s3 cp kms-usage.csv s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1745554322/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

Auditor_Jess: For RBAC diffs include terraform plan output, terraform state diff and `git log` snippet showing approver and timestamp. Also include the approval artifact (email or Slack confirm).

Dmitri: We'll attach `terraform plan -out=plan` artifacts and `git log -1 --pretty=format:\"%h %an %ad %s\"` for the change commit. Approval thread link will be included.

Maria S.: Vulnerability note: the RBAC tighten was mitigation for CVE-2024-9999 in lib X. Attach triage doc, patch PR, canary rollout notes, and mitigation timeline.

Auditor_Jess: Please include 3 redacted KMS request rows (principals redacted) showing principal, keyid, action, outcome, timestamp. We will use them for sampling.

Kevin L.: Example redacted sample we'll include:
`principal: user:REDACTED, keyid: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234, action:Decrypt, time:2024-10-28T12:03:22Z, result:Allowed` we'll provide 3 signed rows.

Oncall-Bot: INC-2024-451 backfill completed by dmitri at 2024-11-06T09:12:07Z artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1745554322/backfill.log :white_check_mark:

Maria S.: I'll assemble index.md with control crosswalk mapping filenames to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.8/A.9 and brief rationale + references to incident/PR/triage docs. Ping me if you need CSV vs JSON or different formats. :thumbsup:

Auditor_Jess: Thanks, that should work. I'll pull and validate once uploaded. If anything else is needed I'll DM Maria or reopen in this thread.

Kevin L.: \ud83d\udc4d

Maria S.: Uploading artifacts in ~30m and will post the S3 path here when complete.
